_README.description: Moonshot Kimi via its OpenAI-compatible API (native provider, MOONSHOT_API_KEY).
_README.usage: Base URL https://api.moonshot.ai/v1. Kimi K3 weights are open but 2.8T, so the API is the practical route. Scores pinned to the moonshotai/* OpenRouter mirrors. Verify model IDs against /models if a call 404s.

models.description: Moonshot Kimi K3.1 Pro (released 2026-10-23) - flagship multimodal reasoning model, a post-trained successor of Kimi K3 (1M context; text, image and video input). Direct Moonshot API, $2/$10 per M. AA Intelligence Index 55 (AA lists one row, the reasoning version, so that row is the high-effort anchor). Moonshot also serves kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed, the same model at higher speed and twice the price.

Moonshot Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed (released 2026-10-23) - the same model as Kimi K3.1 Pro, served 2-3x faster per Moonshot (K3.1 Pro runs at about 41 tokens/s on AA). Direct Moonshot API only (OpenRouter does not list it), $4/$20 per M, twice the K3.1 Pro price (price from third-party sites that cite Moonshot). PROVISIONAL score 20: not listed by Artificial Analysis; scored at parity with K3.1 Pro (55 -> 20) on Moonshot's same-capability claim. NEVER auto-selected (auto_selectable false): at the same score auto mode cannot see the speed, so it would pay double for nothing; name it explicitly when speed matters. Revisit when AA publishes.
Moonshot Kimi K3 - flagship agentic MoE (2.8T, 1M context). Direct Moonshot API. Score at the high-effort anchor is interpolated: AA has no high row (low 30, max 44), so high is taken as about 37.
